conventions.topic: 1. App page skeleton (Layout.astro, head slot, body slot)
conventions.summary: Every app page is src/pages/<name>.astro wrapping its markup in <Layout lang=.. spa={true} [showQuickAdd={true}] [bodyClass=..]> (props Layout.astro:7-36). Layout emits BaseHead (shared head), then the page's <Fragment slot='head'> (Layout.astro:41-42), the prop-firm scripts for app pages (43-48), SpaRouter when spa (49), tags server head nodes with data-ssr (55), renders Navbar + the page body slot inside #app-scroll-container (61-68), then UpgradeModal, onboarding.js, navbar.js and page-transition.js (70-78). Head-slot order used by every page: <title data-i18n>, page CSS, CDN libs (supabase-js before /config.js), /config.js, /i18n.js, <script type='module' src='/src/bundle.js'>, page script with data-page-script last (strategies.astro:5-33, dashboard.astro:437-461). Page markup and page modals go in the default slot (inside #app-scroll-container) so they are swapped out on SPA navigation; wrap content in <main class='<page>-main'> (page-transition.js:238-241 animates main/.dashboard-main/.strategies-main...). Element ids are reused across pages (dashboard.js:61-62), so prefix backtest ids (bt-...). Gotchas: BaseHead always prints <title>{title}</title> (BaseHead.astro:120; Layout default 'Wawe Journal', Layout.astro:27) BEFORE the head slot, so a page's own <title> is the second title element and the tab keeps showing the first one: pass title= to Layout. Do not re-link /styles.css (BaseHead already loads /styles.css?v=1791686000) and do not render a legacy <nav class='nav'> (old backtest.astro:8 and 189-204 do both: a second, un-versioned stylesheet copy and a duplicate navbar). App pages are noindex by default (Layout.astro:31-33).

conventions.topic: 2. Page JS/CSS linking: data-page-script, ?v= cache busting, service-worker caching
conventions.summary: Page assets live in public/interface/<page>/js|css/ (dashboard, strategies, calendar, trades, premium-dashboard). Link them from the head slot with ?v=<number> and bump the number on every change (PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md:388; strategies.astro:12,32; dashboard.astro:460). The page's own script MUST be <script src=.. is:inline defer data-page-script>: SpaRouter never matches it against the old head (SpaRouter.astro:226-229) and always re-executes it (340-349). Shared scripts (config.js, i18n.js, bundle.js, quick-add, CDN libs) must NOT get data-page-script: they run once per document (public/config.js:8-30 has top-level const that would throw on re-run). Always use Astro is:inline (no Astro processing/bundling). A local script's SPA identity ignores ?v (SpaRouter.astro:87-101), so /i18n.js and /i18n.js?v=.. on different pages share one execution. Caching: Cloudflare default for JS/CSS/HTML is max-age=0, must-revalidate (public/_headers:9-16); the service worker serves same-origin GETs cache-first (stale-while-revalidate) EXCEPT /interface/, /components/, /src/, /settings/ and *.html (public/sw.js:31-38, 48-63). Root-level files (/styles.css, /cache.js, /i18n.js, /config.js, /buttons.css, /i18n/locales/*.js) can therefore be one visit stale unless their ?v changes; anything under /interface/ is always revalidated. The i18n locale URL carries its own hard-coded version (i18n.js:126). Premium-dashboard sub-modules carry no ?v (PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md:388).

<script src="/interface/dashboard/js/dashboard.js?v=1791642005" is:inline defer data-page-script></script>

// SpaRouter.astro:226-229 (head diff)
if (el.hasAttribute('data-page-script')) return null;
// SpaRouter.astro:347 (shouldRun)
if (s.src) return s.hasAttribute('data-page-script') || !isActive(s.src);

// public/sw.js:33-38 (never cached by the SW)
url.pathname.startsWith('/interface/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/components/') ||
url.pathname.startsWith('/src/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/settings/')

conventions.topic: 3. CDN libraries and the exact Lightweight Charts 4.1.3 URL
conventions.summary: Third-party libraries are pinned exact versions from cdn.jsdelivr.net, loaded in the head slot as <script src=.. is:inline defer> (optionally preceded by <link rel='preload' as='script'>). Lightweight Charts = https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lightweight-charts@4.1.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js, which defines the global window.LightweightCharts; it is loaded by dashboard.astro:442, premium-dashboard.astro:23 and the old backtest.astro:184 (preload) + 186. Others: @supabase/supabase-js@2.117.3 (dashboard.astro:443, strategies.astro:16; must precede /config.js, which creates window.sb, public/config.js:32-37), apexcharts@8.2.0, sortablejs@1.15.0 (premium only), lucide@0.441.0 (BaseHead.astro:189-190). SpaRouter gives jsDelivr npm URLs the identity 'npm:<pkg>' with version = full URL; if the next page requests a different URL of a package already loaded in the tab, the SPA swap is cancelled and a full page load happens (SpaRouter.astro:92-101, 127-140). So the backtest page must use the byte-identical LWC URL (same version AND same dist file) as dashboard/premium-dashboard. Moving to LWC 5.x would also change the API (addSeries/createSeriesMarkers) on all three pages.

conventions.topic: 4. Boot sequence: dependency readiness, requireAuth, active journal
conventions.summary: Page scripts boot with `if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();` (dashboard.js:3371-3375; this also works under the SPA because SpaRouter fakes readyState and replays DOMContentLoaded). start() checks PAGE.alive, then polls for the globals created by deferred/module scripts (window.ApexCharts/LightweightCharts, window.sb, window.requireAuth, window.journal) every 50 ms up to 160 attempts and hides skeletons on timeout (dashboard.js:3318-3352; strategies.js:1910-1927 uses 30 ms). Init then does `var user = await requireAuth(); if (!user) return;` (dashboard.js:3219-3229) and `await window.journal.ensureActiveJournal(user.id)` (3231-3234). requireAuth (public/src/core/supabase.js:78-139, put on window by script.js:191) waits for OAuth params, redirects to relative 'login.html' when there is no session (112), loads the profile with a 3-minute sessionStorage cache (27-76), signs out is_active=false accounts (125-131) and throttles last_active. Caveat: with ?test=1 and no session it returns a fake {id:'demo-user-id'} user (109-111) - never write with it. window.showToast/requireAuth/getUserPlan/isPremium exist only after /src/bundle.js has run (script.js:165-261), so call them defensively (dashboard.js:205-211).

conventions.topic: 5. wwPage lifecycle (PAGE.on / onLeave / expose / onI18nChange) and timer cleanup
conventions.summary: BaseHead.astro:52-113 defines window.wwPage. A page script takes `var PAGE = window.wwPage.current();` at its top (dashboard.js:54, strategies.js:17, dashboard.astro:465, backtest.astro:324). PageScope API: alive (bool); on(target, type, fn, opts) adds a listener and removes it on leave, ignored if the page already left (65-69); onLeave(fn) registers a cleanup, or runs it at once if the page already left (58-64); expose(name, value) sets window[name] and deletes it on leave if nobody overwrote it (72-77) - used for hooks other code calls, e.g. window.loadTrades after a cTrader sync (calendar.js:1217-1218, journals.astro:2230); onI18nChange(fn) subscribes to i18n.onChange behind an alive guard and unsubscribes on leave (78-91). SpaRouter calls wwPage._next() before swapping content (SpaRouter.astro:299-305); _leave() sets alive=false and runs cleanups in reverse order (92-100). On a full page load nothing happens (comment line 51). Cleanup examples: old backtest replay timer + chart (backtest.astro:435-442; pause() clears the setInterval, 559-569); strategies.js:1944-1957 (clearInterval of the Apex poller, destroy charts); admin-data.js:100-110 (removeChannel for realtime + clearInterval polling); premium-dashboard.js:810-825 (clearTimeout, cancelAnimationFrame, MutationObserver.disconnect, destroy charts); dashboard.js:3322-3325 (WwChartViewer.close + destroyAllCharts) and 3194 (themeObserver.disconnect). For backtest: every replay setInterval/setTimeout/requestAnimationFrame loop, ResizeObserver, MutationObserver, LWC chart (chart.remove()), realtime channel and every node appended to document.body must be released in PAGE.onLeave.

conventions.topic: 6. SpaRouter behaviour and its implications (re-runs, globals, double-init guards)
conventions.summary: SPA pages are listed in SPA_PATHS (SpaRouter.astro:62-75; '/backtest' already at line 71) and need spa={true}. A swap replaces only the children of #app-scroll-container (navbar stays) and the data-ssr head nodes, keeps runtime classes on html/body, swaps body classes from data-page-class and the data-quick-add flag (246-295), then runs the new page's scripts in real-load order: blocking -> deferred (module + defer) -> captured DOMContentLoaded/window load listeners -> i18n.apply() -> lucide.createIcons() -> document event 'ww:page-load' (368-454). While running, document.readyState is faked ('loading' then 'interactive') and DOMContentLoaded/load listeners added by scripts are queued instead of attached (376-391). Re-run rules (340-349): inline scripts (body or head-slot) run on every visit, src scripts with data-page-script run on every visit, other src scripts only if not loaded yet in this tab, type=module scripts only once per document (premium-dashboard re-mounts on 'ww:page-load', premium-dashboard.js:851-869). Implications: (1) no top-level const/let/class in classic page scripts (re-run -> 'already declared'): wrap in an IIFE (dashboard.js:49, backtest.astro:319-323) or use var; (2) window/document listeners only via PAGE.on, elements appended to document.body (JS-built modals, tooltips) removed in onLeave; (3) after every await check PAGE.alive (dashboard.js:60-69 safeEl) and use refresh tokens for overlapping loads (dashboard.js:2990-3003), because ids are reused across pages; (4) per-visit init guards live inside the IIFE (dashboard.js:3175-3178), once-per-document guards use window flags (navbar.js:1760-1763); (5) top-level var/function declarations become window globals that outlive the page - publish hooks with PAGE.expose; (6) a new build id or a CDN version conflict forces a full load (121-140), prefetched HTML is cached 5 min (76, 182-194), SPA navigation is disabled while the onboarding modal/tour is open (164-171).

conventions.topic: 7. Shared chart theme: WwChart (chart-theme.js) and chart-theme.css
conventions.summary: public/interface/shared/chart-theme.js (BaseHead.astro:181; tests/chart-theme.test.js) exposes window.WwChart = {FONT, SIZE, BAR, barSize, isLight, colors, esc, tipHtml, axisLabels, apexBase, apex, lwcBase, lwc, mergeDeep} (179-194). WwChart.lwc(opts) = mergeDeep(lwcBase(), opts), caller keys win (119-134, 177). lwcBase (154-175): layout {background {type 'solid', color 'transparent'}, textColor colors().axis, fontFamily DM Sans, fontSize 12}; grid {vertLines hidden, horzLines colors().grid}; crosshair vertLine/horzLine {color muted, width 1, style 3 (LargeDashed), labelBackgroundColor colors().surface}; right/left price scale and timeScale borderVisible false. It does NOT set width/height/autoSize, localization, handleScroll/handleScale or any series colours. colors() (19-32) dark: text #e8e8f0, muted #a8a8c0, axis #c9c9d6, grid rgba(255,255,255,0.05), zero rgba(168,168,192,0.28), up #22c55e, down #ef4444, surface #000000, line rgba(255,255,255,0.1); light: #1e293b, #64748b, #475569, rgba(15,23,42,0.06), rgba(100,116,139,0.35), #16a34a, #dc2626, #ffffff, rgba(15,23,42,0.1). Values are read at call time (header line 6), so charts must be rebuilt when the theme flips (dashboard.js:351-367 driven by a MutationObserver on body class, 3184-3195; premium-dashboard.js:92-102). Canvases are transparent over #000 cards (dark) / white (light). Hover cards: WwChart.tipHtml({title, value, valueCls 'up'|'down', rows:[{label, value, cls, color, sep, html}]}) escapes text and produces .ww-tip (45-60; styled chart-theme.css:29-65). The old backtest hard-codes candle colours (backtest.astro:430-434) - use colors().up/down. Gotcha: isLight() reads document.body.classList (13-16) but BaseHead copies light-theme from <html> to <body> only on DOMContentLoaded (BaseHead.astro:276-293), and defer page scripts run before that; dashboard.js:12-22 and strategies.js:23+ therefore start with an initTheme() that sets body.light-theme. Build charts after an await or do the same.

conventions.topic: 8. How dashboard / premium-dashboard use Lightweight Charts; resize; WwChartViewer
conventions.summary: dashboard.js routes options through wwLwc() -> WwChart.lwc (282-291). Cumulative P&L (renderCumulativeLwc 1184-1437): createChart(container, wwLwc({width, height, grid, crosshair, price scales, timeScale {timeVisible, tickMarkFormatter...}, handleScroll/handleScale, localization {locale, dateFormat, timeFormatter, priceFormatter}})) (1250-1301); addBaselineSeries with autoscaleInfoProvider (1305-1333); setData (1334); createPriceLine for the zero line (1337) and target/stop lines kept in series._lines and removed with removePriceLine before redrawing (1358-1383); HTML chips placed with series.priceToCoordinate (1343-1356); subscribeCrosshairMove + WwChart.tipHtml hover card (1387-1415); setVisibleLogicalRange/fitContent (1417-1434). Time points are forced strictly increasing (1221). Daily P&L: addHistogramSeries with per-point colour (1545-1554). Instances are kept in lwcCharts{} and destroyed with chart.remove() in destroyAllCharts() (1146-1170), called on every re-render, on theme change (351-367) and in PAGE.onLeave (3322-3325). Resize: one ResizeObserver per container, ignores width changes < 2 px, 80 ms debounce, chart.applyOptions({width, height}) + fitContent (424-484), disconnected by cleanupResizeObservers (486-494); the old backtest used PAGE.on(window,'resize') (backtest.astro:435-437); premium debounces window resize 300 ms -> forceResizeAllCharts -> applyOptions (premium-dashboard.js:104-112, dashboard-manager.js:196-237). Premium cumulative (chart-renderers.js:915-1133): createChart(container, W.lwc(opts)) (1012), addLineSeries/addBaselineSeries/addAreaSeries by widget option (1022-1050), createPriceLine with LightweightCharts.LineStyle.Dashed for prop levels (1054-1075), CrosshairMode.Magnet (1003), tooltip from param.seriesData.get(series) (1097-1132). setMarkers is used nowhere in the repo; addCandlestickSeries and series.update appear only in the old backtest (backtest.astro:430-434, 553). Expanded view: WwChartViewer.open({items:[{key,title}], index, render(el, item, size) -> handle, footer?, onClose?}) (chart-viewer.js:9-20, 168-180); an LWC chart handle is resized through its resize(w,h) and destroyed through remove() (113-129); dashboard wraps it as {resize, destroy} (dashboard.js:2324-2337); pages call WwChartViewer.close() in onLeave (dashboard.js:2297-2299, strategies.js:947-949) and the viewer also closes on pagehide (chart-viewer.js:214). Per the user's preference the expanded chart is this centered modal (up to 1560 px wide, chart clamp(340px, 52vh, 720px)), not full screen (chart-theme.css:139-141, 228-233).

conventions.topic: 9. Lightweight Charts 4.1.3 API for the backtest + mandatory TradingView attribution
conventions.summary: Verified against the 4.1.3 package on jsDelivr (dist/typings.d.ts, README.md). Global LightweightCharts (standalone build). chart.addCandlestickSeries(opts) (typings 1266-1269; old backtest.astro:430-434). series.setData(bars): {time, open, high, low, close}, time = UTCTimestamp seconds | 'YYYY-MM-DD' | BusinessDay (typings 3667), ascending and unique. series.update(bar): appends a bar, or replaces the last bar when time is equal; time must be >= the last bar time (typings 1747-1770) - the incremental replay primitive (old backtest.astro:553). series.setMarkers(markers) REPLACES all markers; the array must be sorted by time; marker = {time, position 'aboveBar'|'belowBar'|'inBar', shape 'circle'|'square'|'arrowUp'|'arrowDown', color, id?, text?, size?} (typings 1819-1859, 2896-2922, 3600-3604). series.createPriceLine({price, color, lineWidth, lineStyle, axisLabelVisible, title}) returns an IPriceLine whose applyOptions({price}) moves it; series.removePriceLine(line) deletes it (typings 1616-1638, 1866-1891) - fits entry/SL/TP lines. chart.applyOptions / resize(w, h) / remove() (typings 1192, 1201, 1212); 4.1.3 also has autoSize: true (typings 739-749), unused in the repo. Enums: LineStyle Solid 0, Dotted 1, Dashed 2, LargeDashed 3, SparseDotted 4; CrosshairMode Normal 0, Magnet 1, Hidden 2 (the repo mixes named enums with raw numbers: style: 3, mode: 0). LWC renders times in UTC; the repo shows user-tz wall clock by feeding pseudo-UTC seconds (see WwTime). LICENSE: the 4.1.3 README says the license requires naming TradingView as the product creator and adding the NOTICE attribution plus a link to https://www.tradingview.com/ on the page users see. No page in src/ or public/ links to tradingview.com today (grep; the only TradingView asset is the landing-page platform-strip logo public/images/platforms/tradingview.svg at index.astro:173,185, not an attribution) - dashboard and premium-dashboard are already out of compliance too. 4.1.3 has no attributionLogo chart option (absent from its typings), so add a visible HTML link; the NOTICE file is not in the npm tarball (jsDelivr /NOTICE returns 404), take its text from the project's GitHub repository.

conventions.topic: 10. Design tokens, fonts, light theme
conventions.summary: Tokens are one :root block in public/styles.css:22-79 (dark default): --bg #07070c, --bg2 #0d0d14, --surface #0e0e16, --surface2 #161620, --border rgba(123,110,246,0.12), --border2 rgba(123,110,246,0.2), --accent #8b5cf6, --accent2 #c084fc, --accent3 #a78bfa, --accent-glow, --green #22c55e (+ -bg/-glow), --red #ef4444 (+ -bg/-glow), --yellow #fbbf24, --cyan, --pink, --text #f1f1f8, --text-muted/--muted #a0a0b8, --radius 12px / --radius-sm 8px / --radius-lg 20px, --font 'DM Sans', --font-display 'Syne', --font-mono 'DM Mono' (never loaded), z-index scale (--z-dropdown 300 ... --z-modal-overlay 1000, --z-modal-content 1001, --z-toast 9999). Light theme overrides the same variables on body.light-theme (85-119: --bg #f4f4f9, --surface #fff, --accent #6c5ce7, --green #10b981, --red #dc2626, --text #0f172a, --muted #64748b ...). BaseHead adds light-theme to <html> synchronously from localStorage.ww_theme and copies it to <body> on DOMContentLoaded (BaseHead.astro:206-293); premium custom themes rewrite --bg/--surface/--accent inline (220-235), which is why dark cards/modals hard-code #000. Write light rules on body.light-theme / .light-theme and dark-only rules on body:not(.light-theme) or :root:not(.light-theme) body:not(.light-theme). Fonts: app pages load Google Fonts DM Sans 400-700, JetBrains Mono 400/500 and Syne 600-800 with display=block (BaseHead.astro:164); public/auth pages load Space Grotesk + DM Sans + JetBrains Mono with display=swap (195-198). Body text DM Sans (styles.css:200-210); h1-h5 Syne with a gradient text fill (232-248) - to colour a heading reset background and -webkit-text-fill-color (old backtest.astro:149-150); .stat-value/.kpi-value/.trade-pnl use 'Inter', which is never loaded (250-259). Charts and numbers: DM Sans + font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (chart-theme.css:38-42, 130-137); user preference: DM Sans (600, tabular-nums) for numbers, not JetBrains Mono/DM Mono (the old backtest uses DM Mono everywhere, backtest.astro:55,122,129,148). Shared component classes: .page-header (266), .stats-grid/.stat-card (304/311), .chart-card/.chart-header/.chart-badge (437/448/465), .card (1743-1748), .ww-table (1254-1312), .badge-long/.badge-short (1576/1581), .skeleton* (1880+).

conventions.topic: 11. Pure-black dark-mode rule: exact selectors for cards, modals, viewer, quick-add, navbar
conventions.summary: Rule (PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md:335 + user memory): in dark mode charts, tooltips, cards and modals are plain #000 with neutral hairlines rgba(255,255,255,0.05-0.1), never the purple-tinted --surface/--border; light mode is white. Cards: styles.css:2806-2836 `:root:not(.light-theme) body:not(.light-theme) :is(.stat-card, ..., .bt-chart-card, .bt-trade-panel) { background:#000 }` (old backtest classes listed at 2832-2833) and dashboard.css:3055-3066. The generic .modal-box is NOT black by itself (styles.css:2651-2664 uses var(--surface)); pages override it, e.g. strategies.css:1067-1072 plus #000 header border/inputs/tables/buttons (1073-1097). Chart viewer: chart-theme.css:142-179 (.ww-viewer --ww-viewer-bg #000, --ww-viewer-line rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg,#07070c) 82%, transparent) + blur(14px); .ww-viewer-box background var(--ww-viewer-bg), 1px border var(--ww-viewer-line), radius 20px, shadow 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)); light (158-163): --ww-viewer-bg #fff, --ww-viewer-line #e2e8f0, backdrop rgba(15,23,42,0.45). Hover card: --ww-tip-bg rgba(0,0,0,0.96), --ww-tip-line rgba(255,255,255,0.1) (8-17), light rgba(255,255,255,0.97) (18-27). Quick-add modal: quick-add.css:36 --qa-surface #000000 (fields use --qa-surface2 #0d0d14 / --qa-surface3 #16161f, borders rgba(232,232,240,0.08/0.16)); .quick-add-modal {background var(--qa-surface); border 1px solid var(--qa-border-strong); border-top 3px solid var(--qa-accent)} (165-182); overlay rgba(8,8,14,0.78) + blur(12px) (136-148); light white (46-60). Navbar dropdowns: navbar.css:3590-3614 (#000, backdrop-filter none, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), shadow 0 24px 64px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.9)). Expanded-chart summary dashboard.css:3021-3024 (--ce-surface #000, --ce-line rgba(255,255,255,0.07)); premium export dialog premium-dashboard.css:35-49 (--pdx-bg #000, --pdx-line rgba(255,255,255,0.09)). Buttons: buttons.css:10-46 forces .btn-primary/.btn-ghost/.btn-modal-confirm/.btn-modal-cancel/.btn-export ... to #000 fill + 1px #7c3aed outline (danger/sell intentionally excluded).

conventions.topic: 12. Modal, toast, confirm and upgrade patterns
conventions.summary: Modal markup (strategies.astro:198-223), placed in the page body slot: div.modal-overlay#id > div.modal-box[.modal-box-lg|.modal-box-md] > .modal-header (h3[data-i18n] + button.modal-close) / .modal-body (.modal-field label + input) / .modal-footer (button.btn-modal-cancel + button.btn-modal-confirm). styles.css:2628-2668 only provides the shell: fixed inset 0, rgba(0,0,0,0.85) + blur(6px), z-index var(--z-modal-overlay), hidden by default and shown by adding class active or open or inline display:flex; .modal-box max-width 600px (lg 880px), max-height 90dvh, flex column. Header/body/footer/field/close styles are page CSS (strategies.css:766-830; calendar.css, admin.css), so the backtest CSS must style them plus the #000 dark override. Close on backdrop click via e.target === overlay (dashboard.js:2823-2825). Toast: window.showToast(message, type) from public/src/utils/ui.js:16-79 (window export script.js:181); type 'success' (default) | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info'; text via textContent (safe), emojis stripped (35), stacked in #ww-toast-container (styles.css:1594-1612), auto-dismiss 3.5 s (75); only available after bundle.js - wrap it (dashboard.js:205-211). Confirm: there is NO working shared confirm API. public/src/utils/confirm-dialog.js (window.confirmDialog({title|titleKey, message|messageKey, params, confirmKey, cancelKey, variant, icon, onConfirm, onCancel})) is not imported by script.js and no page references it, so it never loads (it also interpolates title/message into innerHTML unescaped, 39-55). Pages use native confirm() (trades.js:791, strategies.js:736, journals.astro:1119/1634), page-local .confirm-modal markup styled by styles.css:1754-1873 (trades.astro:166+ bulk delete), or settings.js showConfirmModal(title, message, warning, onConfirm, onCancel) (settings.js:966-1016, settings page only). Upgrade prompt: window.openUpgradeModal({feature, tier, period}) (UpgradeModal.astro:811-827); feature-specific notices exist only for journal/account, premium_dashboard/dashboard, csv/csv_import, everything else gets the default text (771-793, strings in its own inline I18N_DICT ~540-640).

conventions.topic: 13. i18n: window.i18n API, locale files, data-i18n attributes, re-apply after rendering
conventions.summary: public/i18n.js creates window.i18n and window.i18nReady (378-382). It loads only the active language plus English with dynamic import from I18N_PATH './i18n/locales/' + lang + '.js?v=1791896800' (22-24, 121-143); supported 'en', 'tr', 'de' (26); the language is localStorage.ww_language, defaulted to 'en' by BaseHead (BaseHead.astro:313-325). API: t(key, params) - lookup current lang -> en -> small critical fallback -> key; params replace {name} or {{name}} (177-201); apply() translates [data-i18n] (textContent), [data-i18n-html] (innerHTML), [data-i18n-placeholder], [data-i18n-title], with optional JSON [data-i18n-params], and leaves server text untouched when a key is missing (260-327); setLanguage(lang) -> Promise<boolean>, then apply() and onChange listeners called with the new lang (205-251); getCurrentLanguage(), onChange(cb), refresh(), isReady(), loadLanguage(). There is no DOM event for language change: pages use PAGE.onI18nChange(fn) (BaseHead.astro:78-91); navbar also reacts to the cross-tab storage event (navbar.js:2025-2032). Locale files public/i18n/locales/{en,tr,de}.js are ES modules `export default { 'flat.dotted.key': 'value', ... }` grouped by comments (en.js:6+); there are no backtest.* keys yet (only settings.delete_confirm_warning mentions backtest data: en.js:860, tr.js:806, de.js:829). Markup: keep the Turkish/default text in the element and put data-i18n on it (strategies.astro:41-42); never put data-i18n on an element whose children must survive (textContent wipes them) - use data-i18n-html or wrap the text in a span. Dynamic content: either build strings with i18n.t() and re-render in PAGE.onI18nChange (dashboard.js:3295-3303), or inject HTML that carries data-i18n attributes and call i18n.apply() + lucide.createIcons() afterwards (strategies.js:605-607, 764, 1880-1884). SpaRouter also calls i18n.apply() after the swap and after scripts (SpaRouter.astro:330-333, 447-449). A local fallback helper _t(key, fallback) is common (premium-dashboard.js:60-68, chart-viewer.js:31-39). After changing locale files bump the ?v at i18n.js:126 (SW cache-first). Keys referenced by shared code but missing in all locales: common.confirm (confirm-dialog.js:10), common.previous, common.next (chart-viewer.js:58-59) - their fallbacks are Turkish.

conventions.topic: 14. Supabase client, current user, active journal, plan/premium checks
conventions.summary: Client: window.sb - created by /config.js when supabase-js is already loaded (public/config.js:32-37), otherwise by the bundle (public/src/core/supabase.js:19-23); script.js:166 re-exports it; page code uses sb.from(...) / window.sb (dashboard.js:3091). Never create a second client (old backtest.astro:341-353 reuses window.sb for that reason; it also hard-codes the anon key 333-339). Current user: await requireAuth() (entry 4); journals.astro also sets window.currentUser (1381-1401). Active journal: window.journal = {getActiveJournalId, setActiveJournalId(id, silent), ensureActiveJournal(userId), listJournals, createJournal, updateJournal, deleteJournal, switchDefaultJournal, getJournal} (public/src/core/journal.js:181-193); the id is localStorage.ww_active_journal_id (5-8); setActiveJournalId dispatches window CustomEvent 'journal-changed' {detail:{id, oldId}} unless silent (10-22); ensureActiveJournal validates the stored id against rpc list_journals and silently falls back to the default/first journal (91-121). The navbar journal switch writes localStorage directly, dispatches 'journal-changed' on window and reloads/redirects 135 ms later (page-transition.js:400-510), so pages are refreshed by that reload. Reads are scoped .eq('user_id', uid).eq('journal_id', jid), 1000-row pages ordered trade_date desc, id asc (dashboard.js:3084-3123) with a legacy journal_id IS NULL fallback (3127-3155). Plan: getUserPlan() -> {plan, features} (user.js:21-84; 5-min sessionStorage cache ww_user_plan/_time/_exp; an expired plan_expires_at counts as free via isPremiumExpired 15-19; side effect: 'premium.expired' toast at 61), getUserPlanSilent() same without the toast (86-130), isPremium() (132-135), hasFeature(name) on FEATURES (137-140; FEATURES is duplicated in public/src/core/config.js:14-69 and public/config.js:47-102, no backtest key), requirePremium() redirects to settings.html#panel-plan with a hard-coded Turkish toast (142-161). BaseHead toggles .is-premium on html/body from the cached plan before first paint (BaseHead.astro:266-272, 282-286). Reference gate: premium-dashboard.js:710-735 (cached plan -> getUserPlan -> openUpgradeModal({feature}) + inline teaser; background re-check reloads on downgrade). User preference: no lock icons for Pro gating (use quota/teaser patterns). DB-side premium = plan = 'premium' AND (plan_expires_at IS NULL OR plan_expires_at > now()) (db/fn_check_prop_account_limit.sql:63).

conventions.topic: 15. wwCache (public/cache.js): API, key format, invalidation after mutations
conventions.summary: window.wwCache (BaseHead.astro:171, no ?v). Key = (prefix||'trades') + ':' + (userId||'anon') + ':' + (journalId||'all') (24-26); kept in a Map and in sessionStorage['ww_cache_'+key] when the list has <= 3000 rows (77, 182); TTL 2 min (21). API: get(prefix, userId, journalId, needCols?) returns data only if fresh and the first row has every needCols column (89-164); set(prefix, userId, journalId, array) (169-205); invalidate(prefix?) clears the WHOLE memory Map and every sessionStorage key starting with 'ww_cache_'+prefix (210-225). Prefixes in use: 'trades' (trades.js:1045), 'trades_dashboard' (ascending order; dashboard.js:3078/3161, dashboard.astro:1162), 'trades_strategies' (strategies.js:1573/1666), 'trades_premium' (premium-dashboard.js:629/759), 'trades_calendar' (calendar.js:867/925), 'strategies' (strategies.js:1572/1663). Any prefix that starts with 'trades' is cross-fed with the main 'trades'/'trades_dashboard' lists (121-158, 189-202): a backtest cache must use another prefix (e.g. 'bt_...'). Automatic invalidation (232-250): window 'trade-saved' and 'trade-deleted' -> invalidate('trades'); 'strategy-saved'/'strategy-deleted' -> invalidate('strategies'); storage event for ww_active_journal_id -> both. Mutation call sites: add trade / CSV import add-trade.astro:1263-1264, 1533-1534, 1654-1655 (invalidate('trades') + dispatch 'trade-saved'); quick-add.js:2186, 2198, 2533 ('trade-saved'); edit trades.js:1430 ('trade-saved'); delete trades.js:811, 869 ('trade-deleted' + 'trade-saved'); trades.js:1494-1512 (window.loadTrades = invalidate + re-init; PAGE.on(window, 'trade-saved')); cTrader sync navbar.js:2593-2599 (invalidate('trades') + invalidate('trades_dashboard') + 'trade-saved' + 'journal-changed') then window.loadTrades() or a reload (2601-2611); strategies.js:738-739, 981-986, 1054-1055. ctrader-callback.astro does NOT invalidate after its first sync (248-271).

conventions.topic: 16. cTrader sync Edge Function: deal -> trades row mapping, upsert, chunking
conventions.summary: supabase/functions/ctrader-sync/index.ts (Deno std@0.177.0 serve, esm.sh supabase-js@2). Flow: CORS allowlist + OPTIONS 204 (14-26, 54-72, 165); POST only; Bearer token verified with createClient(URL, ANON).auth.getUser(token) (168-179); body {ctidTraderAccountId, journalId} (186-191); service-role admin client (193-195); the account must belong to the user (198-207); target journal = body.journalId || account.journal_id and must be the user's active journal (209-226); if it differs, the account's journal_id is updated and its cursor nulled (228-237); 5-min syncing_since lock -> 429 (239-255); token refresh when < 1 day left, needs_reconnect on failure (257-302); WebSocket live/demo.ctraderapi.com:5036 (304-319); moneyDigits and balance via 2121 (324-363); window start = cursor - 2 days, else max(registration, now - 90 d), else now - 30 d (365-375). Chunking: 6-day windows (437), ProtoOAGetDealListReq 2133 with maxRows 100 + hasMore paging and 250 ms sleeps (474-484, 634-645), 90 s budget -> done:false (438, 457-472); only deals with dealStatus 2/3 and closePositionDetail (487); deals whose lot size could not be confirmed are skipped and the cursor held back (489-513, 540-547). Mapping (593-614): user_id; journal_id = target; symbol upper-case without separators (532-536); direction 'LONG' if the closing deal is SELL else 'SHORT' (553-555); instrument = guessInstrument (43-52); lot = closedVolume/lotSize at 4 dp (556-562); entry_price = closePositionDetail.entryPrice || executionPrice, exit_price = executionPrice (590-591); gross_pnl = grossProfit/10^moneyDigits, commission = |commission|/divisor (stored positive), swap = swap/divisor (signed), pnl = gross - commission + swap, each toFixed(clamp(moneyDigits, 2, 8)) (549-573, 602-605); trade_date = exit_date = closing execution time as ISO (open time is not stored) (606-607); multiplier = MULTIPLIER_MAP[instrument] (28-34, 575); platform_source 'ctrader'; position_id String(positionId); last_deal_id Number(dealId); import_hash 'ctrader:<ctidTraderAccountId>:<dealId>'; created_at now. Not set: stop_loss, take_profit, rr_ratio, notes, strategy_id, is_quick_entry. Write: admin.from('trades').upsert(chunk, {onConflict: 'user_id,journal_id,import_hash', ignoreDuplicates: true}).select('id') in 200-row chunks (617-632) plus a final flush (653-667); inserted = returned ids, skipped = the rest. Afterwards cursor = latest deal time (or processedUntil on timeout, held before skipped deals) and the lock released (691-710); balance written separately (712-733); response {success, done, balance, balance_currency, balance_source, inserted, skipped, fetched, warnings, message} (735-748); errors set last_error and return 400 (750-762).
conventions.excerpt:

conventions.topic: 17. cTrader client callers, link/unlink/move semantics, and a live unique-index hazard
conventions.summary: Callers: navbar.js:2492-2611 window.wwSyncCtrader(e, ctid, journalId, btn) - fetch(SUPABASE_URL + '/functions/v1/ctrader-sync') POST with Content-Type, Authorization: Bearer <session.access_token>, apikey: <anon key>, looping while data.done === false up to 10 rounds (2520-2550); needs_reconnect -> /journals.html; then summary/warning toasts, cache invalidation + 'trade-saved' + 'journal-changed' (2593-2599) and window.loadTrades() if a page exposed it, else ww_pending_toasts + reload (2601-2611). trades.astro:349-388 shows the sync button for the active journal via rpc('get_ctrader_status') and calls wwSyncCtrader. ctrader-callback.astro:219-271 posts the OAuth code to ctrader-connect; if localStorage.ww_ctrader_target_journal is set it runs rpc('link_ctrader_account', {p_account_id, p_journal_id}), sets ww_active_journal_id and fires the first ctrader-sync (no cache invalidation). journals.astro:1113-1140 and 1630-1642 call rpc('unlink_ctrader_account', {p_account_id}) after a native confirm that says trades are kept; 2015-2027 and 2177-2189 call link_ctrader_account. Live SQL: link_ctrader_account (db/fn_link_ctrader_account.sql:12-38) checks journal ownership + is_active and account ownership, NULLs any other account linked to that journal, then sets journal_id; unlink_ctrader_account (db/fn_unlink_ctrader_account.sql:12-16) only sets journal_id = NULL; trigger trg_ctrader_reset_cursor BEFORE UPDATE (db/triggers_core.json) -> ctrader_reset_cursor_on_journal_change NULLs last_deal_timestamp whenever journal_id changes (db/fn_ctrader_reset_cursor_on_journal_change.sql:7-9; repo 202610150003:19-35); disconnect_ctrader deletes tokens and accounts (db/fn_disconnect_ctrader.sql:12-13). None of them touch trades: the old journal keeps its rows (platform_source 'ctrader', same position_id and import_hash); deleting a journal deletes its trades (db/fn_delete_journal.sql:26) and ctrader_accounts.journal_id is ON DELETE SET NULL (202610120001:36). HAZARD (inferred from the live indexes plus PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT semantics, not reproduced): trades has live-only UNIQUE indexes idx_trades_journal_position (journal_id, position_id) and trades_platform_unique (user_id, platform_source, position_id) WHERE both NOT NULL (db/trades_indexes.json), but the upsert's arbiter is only (user_id, journal_id, import_hash). After an account is moved to another journal, the cursor reset re-imports up to 90 days whose position_ids already exist in the old journal -> 23505 on trades_platform_unique -> the whole 200-row statement fails, last_error is set and the cursor never advances; partial closes (two closing deals of one position) fail the same way on both indexes. Any backtest row given a non-null position_id is subject to the same two indexes.
conventions.excerpt:
-- db/trades_indexes.json (live, not in any migration)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_trades_journal_position ON public.trades USING btree (journal_id, position_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX trades_platform_unique ON public.trades USING btree (user_id, platform_source, position_id)
  WHERE ((platform_source IS NOT NULL) AND (position_id IS NOT NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_trades_user_journal_import_hash ON public.trades USING btree (user_id, journal_id, import_hash)

-- db/fn_unlink_ctrader_account.sql:12-14
UPDATE public.ctrader_accounts
SET journal_id = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = p_account_id AND user_id = v_uid;
-- db/fn_ctrader_reset_cursor_on_journal_change.sql:7-9
IF NEW.journal_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.journal_id THEN
  NEW.last_deal_timestamp := NULL;
END IF;

conventions.topic: 18. Live trades table: triggers trg_calc_pnl / trg_trades_default_journal, constraints, RLS - consequences for inserting backtest trades
conventions.summary: Columns (db/trades_columns.json): NOT NULL user_id, symbol, direction, instrument (default 'forex'), lot, trade_date; nullable journal_id, strategy_id, multiplier (no default), entry/exit_price, stop_loss, take_profit, pnl, rr_ratio, notes, exit_date, platform_source, import_hash, gross_pnl, position_id; defaults is_quick_entry false, last_deal_id 0, status 'closed', commission 0, swap 0, created_at/updated_at now(). Constraints (db/trades_constraints.json): direction IN ('LONG','SHORT','BUY','SELL') (case-sensitive), journal FK ON DELETE SET NULL, user FK ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE (user_id, journal_id, import_hash); plus the position_id unique indexes (entry 17). RLS (db/policies_core.json): INSERT WITH CHECK user_id = auth.uid() AND journal_id IN (the user's journals) - stricter than the repo baseline (202608190001:122-123); SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE user_id = auth.uid() OR is_admin(). trg_calc_pnl BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE -> calc_trade_pnl(): if pnl IS NOT NULL it is kept as sent, but whenever stop_loss, take_profit and entry_price are all set rr_ratio is OVERWRITTEN with ROUND(|tp - entry| / |entry - sl|, 2) (the planned R:R, never a realised R), and updated_at = NOW() (db/fn_calc_trade_pnl.sql:9-26); is_quick_entry = true or a missing entry/exit leaves pnl NULL (28-38); otherwise pnl = dir * (exit - entry) * lot * mult rounded to 2 dp with mult forex 100000, gold 100, index 10, crypto 1, other COALESCE(multiplier, 1) and ELSE 100000 - 'stock' or any other instrument string gets 100000 and multiplier is ignored except for 'other' (40-53); dir is +1 only for 'LONG'/'BUY'. trg_trades_default_journal BEFORE INSERT -> set_default_journal(): a NULL journal_id is silently replaced by the user's is_default journal (db/fn_set_default_journal.sql:8-11). Consequences: (a) a backtest row without journal_id lands in the user's real default journal; (b) every reader treats rows in trades as real trades: 37 .from('trades') call sites in 16 files (dashboard.js, trades.js, calendar.js, strategies.js, premium-dashboard.js, onboarding.js, quick-add.js, overtrade.js, notifications.js, prop-service.js, stats.js, settings.js, navbar.js, add-trade.astro, journals.astro, ctrader-sync) and 10 SQL functions (db/functions_touching_trades.json) incl. list_journals trade_count/total_pnl/win_rate/last_trade_date (db/fn_list_journals.sql:55-62), evaluate_prop_firm_rules (db/fn_evaluate_prop_firm_rules.sql:72-73, 100-101), get_platform_stats / get_today_trades_count (public landing counters by created_at) and get_strategy_performance; none filters on platform_source and the client selects do not even fetch it (dashboard.js:3093); (c) a dedicated 'Backtest' journal would consume the journal quota (free = 2) and show up in the navbar switcher; (d) send pnl explicitly (avoid the 100000 fallback), upper-case direction, a non-null lot; (e) a supplied rr_ratio is lost whenever SL and TP are both present; (f) keep position_id NULL (or unique per journal and per user+platform_source) and use a namespaced import_hash for idempotent upserts (CSV: SYMBOL|DIR|entry|exit|lot|date|ticket, add-trade.astro:1204-1212; cTrader 'ctrader:<acc>:<deal>'); (g) WwMetrics/WwTime use exit_price as the closed flag and trade_date as the day key; (h) after writing, dispatch window 'trade-saved'.

conventions.topic: 19. Live backtest_trades table and every repo reference to it (removal/reuse input)
conventions.summary: Read-only catalog queries today (results in the scratchpad agents/bt_*.json): public.backtest_trades columns id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL, symbol text NOT NULL, asset_class text, interval text, side text NOT NULL, entry_price numeric NOT NULL, exit_price numeric NOT NULL, entry_time timestamptz NOT NULL, exit_time timestamptz NOT NULL, tp_pct numeric, sl_pct numeric, pnl_pct numeric NOT NULL, exit_reason text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz default now(); FK user_id -> auth.users(id) WITHOUT ON DELETE CASCADE; indexes backtest_trades_pkey, idx_backtest_trades_user_id, idx_backtest_trades_created_at (created_at DESC), idx_backtest_trades_user_time (user_id, entry_time DESC); RLS policies 'users select/insert/update/delete own backtest trades' with auth.uid() = user_id (no is_admin, UPDATE without WITH CHECK) - the repo baseline policies backtest_trades_*_own(_or_admin) (202608190001:142-151) are not what is live; row count 0. conventions.topic: 20. Database migration conventions (naming, idempotency, RLS, grants, triggers, quota/premium check)
conventions.summary: Files: supabase/migrations/YYYYMMDDNNNN_snake_description.sql. The version 202610050001 is used twice (..._add_prop_accounts.sql and ..._add_yearly_commission.sql) - use a fresh one (latest is 202610150005, so 20261018NNNN). Migrations are applied by hand in the Supabase SQL Editor: supabase_migrations.schema_migrations is empty in production (db/applied_migrations.json) and README.md:10-16 says the baseline was intentionally not run. The live DB has objects no migration creates (trg_calc_pnl, trg_trades_default_journal, touch_updated_at, idx_trades_journal_position, trades_platform_unique, the journal-checking trades_insert_own policy, the 'users ... own backtest trades' policies), so check the live catalog first and keep scripts idempotent and safe on both a live and a repo-only database (wording and pattern: 202610150001:13-19, 27-41). Layout: banner `-- WAWE JOURNAL - <TITLE>`, `-- Migration: <file>`, `-- Description:` / `Why:` / `Sorun / Çözüm` bullets, deploy-order notes (202610150005:11), BEGIN; numbered sections; COMMIT. DDL: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, journal_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.journals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE (prop) or ON DELETE SET NULL (ctrader), named CHECK chk_* (202610050001:23-39), created_at/updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc'::text, now()) (prop) or now() (ctrader); ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS (202610150001:23-25, 202610150005:16-19) or DO $$ IF NOT EXISTS (information_schema / pg_constraint) $$ (202610030002:12-23, 202610070002:6-40) with COMMENT ON COLUMN (202610070002:16,27,38); CREATE [UNIQUE] INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_<table>_<cols> / uq_<table>_<what>, partial WHERE for 'one active per journal' (202610050001:42-49, 202610120001:47-49); to_regclass('public.x') IS NOT NULL guards (202609200001:48-50). RLS: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS; four policies TO authenticated named <table>_select_own/_insert_own/_update_own/_delete_own (202610050001:52-74; the baseline uses *_own_or_admin, 202608190001:120-151): SELECT/DELETE USING (user_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_admin()), INSERT WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid()), UPDATE USING + WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_admin()); add a journal-ownership clause like the live trades/strategies INSERT policies when journal_id comes from the client (db/policies_core.json). Server-only tables: RLS on, no policies (202610120001:51-57). is_admin() = auth.jwt() app_metadata.role = 'admin' (db/fn_is_admin.sql:6). Functions: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.x(...) RETURNS jsonb|trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public; v_uid := auth.uid(); 'Not authenticated' guard; either RAISE EXCEPTION 'CODE[:%]' that the client maps by substring (journal.js:24-49) or RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', ...) (202610120001:112-154); then REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION ... FROM public; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION ... TO authenticated (202610120001:199-210, 202610050001:234-235). No table GRANTs (Supabase defaults + RLS; only exception system_settings, 202608270001:111). Triggers: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_x ON t; CREATE TRIGGER trg_x BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON t FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.fn() (202610050001:166-169, 202610150003:32-35). check_prop_account_limit (live = repo) is the ownership/quota template: SECURITY DEFINER trigger; INSERT needs a journals row (id = NEW.journal_id, user_id = NEW.user_id, is_active) else RAISE 'INVALID_JOURNAL'; an UPDATE that changes journal_id needs ownership; validates reset_tz against pg_timezone_names and the rules size; quota only on INSERT-active or inactive->active: premium = plan = 'premium' AND (plan_expires_at IS NULL OR plan_expires_at > now()) read from user_profiles by NEW.user_id, max 10 vs 1, counting active rows whose journal is active, RAISE 'PROP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED:%'; sets updated_at = timezone('utc', now()) on UPDATE (db/fn_check_prop_account_limit.sql:14-86). touch_updated_at() exists only live (db/fn_touch_updated_at.sql: NEW.updated_at = now(); used by trg_journals_updated_at) - CREATE OR REPLACE it in your migration before relying on it. Optional verification script: supabase/tests/<feature>_verify.sql, a DO $$ block that ends with RAISE EXCEPTION 'TEST OZETI: ...' so everything rolls back (prop_accounts_verify.sql:1-14).

conventions.topic: 21. Unit tests: vm-loaded browser modules, naming, how to run
conventions.summary: tests/<module>.test.js, ESM (package.json "type": "module"), node:test describe/it (+ before/beforeEach) and node:assert/strict; each file starts with a header naming the file, the runner and the covered module. Browser IIFE modules are loaded by reading the source and running it in a sandbox: vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync(path.resolve('public/...'), 'utf8'), win) with win.window = win and stubs for localStorage, dispatchEvent and CustomEvent plus the needed builtins (trade-metrics.test.js:15-35 loads time-settings.js then trade-metrics.js; chart-theme.test.js:15-21 stubs document.body.classList.contains to switch the light theme; prop-service.test.js:14-37 has a generic loadScriptInVm). ES modules are imported after setting a global window: globalThis.window = makeWindow(); E = await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve('public/interface/premium-dashboard/js/insights-engine.js')).href) inside before() (insights-engine.test.js:16-33). Paths resolve from the repo root, so run from there; timezone-dependent code is pinned with ww_time_settings {tz: 'UTC', dayStart: 0}. Run: node --test tests/*.test.js (PROJECT_OVERVIEW.md:22, 387). On Node 25 `node --test tests/` does not work (directory arguments are not expanded). For backtest: keep the engine (bar replay, fills, SL/TP, stats) a pure IIFE attaching window.WwBacktest (or an ESM with exports) with no DOM/Supabase access at load so it can be tested the same way. Baseline today: 156 tests / 40 suites / 156 pass / 0 fail.

conventions.topic: 22. WwMetrics (trade-metrics.js): what it exposes and reuse for backtest statistics
conventions.summary: public/interface/shared/trade-metrics.js (BaseHead.astro:177, 28 tests) -> window.WwMetrics {toNum, isClosed, closedTrades, tradePnL, dateKey, tradeTime, chronological, equityCurve, maxDrawdown, streaks, sharpe, avgRR, ratio, summarize, formatProfitFactor} (204-220); the single source of truth for P&L / win rate / PF / drawdown on every page. Rules: a trade is closed iff exit_price parses to a number (0 counts) - there are no open trades (9-10, 23-26); tradePnL = stored pnl if numeric, else window.calcPnL(entry, exit, lot, direction, instrument, multiplier) (34-57); dateKey/tradeTime read t.trade_date through WwTime (61-77); chronological sorts by trade_date ms, stable (82-92). summarize(trades) -> {total, wins, losses, breakeven, totalPnL, grossWin, grossLoss, avgWin, avgLoss, winRate (% of all closed), profitFactor (null = infinity), payoff, expectancy, maxDrawdown (positive, money units from a 0 peak), maxWinStreak, maxLossStreak, sharpe (per-trade mean / population SD, null if < 2 trades or SD 0), avgRR (mean of positive rr_ratio only, null if none)} (167-195); equityCurve -> per-trade {trade, pnl, equity, peak, drawdown} (96-104); formatProfitFactor(null) -> '∞' (198-202). Reuse for backtest: yes - map each simulated trade to {exit_price, pnl, trade_date: <exit time ISO or ms>, rr_ratio?, entry_price, lot, direction} and call summarize / equityCurve / streaks. Caveats: drawdown is absolute from 0 (no starting balance, no %) - derive % from equityCurve + the initial balance; if P&L is in percent (old page pnl_pct) everything is additive, not compounded; avgRR ignores values <= 0 so it cannot express realised-R expectancy; exits exactly at 00:00:00.000Z are treated as date-only by dateKey.

conventions.topic: 23. WwTime (time-settings.js): timezone API and how dates/times are formatted
conventions.summary: public/interface/shared/time-settings.js (BaseHead.astro:174) -> window.WwTime (380-414). Settings: localStorage.ww_time_settings {tz: 'auto' | IANA, dayStart 0-23, importTz: 'same' | 'utc' | 'offset:<min>' | IANA, hour12} (21-22, 91-102), cached per document (104-112); setSettings dispatches window 'timeSettingsChanged' (114-120) but nothing listens. getTz() resolves 'auto' to the device zone (131-134). parseMs(raw): ISO without a zone = UTC (151-169). classify(): 'YYYY-MM-DD' and any timestamp exactly at UTC midnight are 'date' (never shifted, no hour) (177-191). dateKey(v) = trading-day key in the user tz after subtracting dayStart hours (199-211); todayKey(), addDays/addMonths (key arithmetic), rangeStartKey('week'|'month'|'year'), previousRangeKeys (213-270). pseudoUtcSeconds(v) = the user-tz wall clock as fake UTC seconds for Lightweight Charts axes; date-only values -> 12:00 of that day (272-286); used by dashboard.js:1199-1208 and premium helpers.js:83. Formatting: formatDate(v, lang, opts) default {day '2-digit', month 'short', year 'numeric'} in the user tz (date-only values in UTC) (331-342); formatDateTime (respects hour12) (345-353); formatTime (322-328); locale map tr -> tr-TR, de -> de-DE, else en-US (311-313); lang defaults to i18n.getCurrentLanguage() or 'tr' (315-320); offsetMinutes, partsInTz, zonedToUtcMs, localWallTimeToIso (user tz -> UTC ISO) and importWallTimeToIso are exposed (370-378). Dates are stored as UTC ISO strings (ctrader-sync/index.ts:606-607). Elsewhere: window.formatDate (helpers.js:145-152) is hard-wired to 'tr'; window.formatCurrency (helpers.js:73-82) always uses tr-TR grouping with a +/- sign; LWC tick and tooltip labels are produced with UTC getters on pseudo-UTC seconds (dashboard.js:588-670, 1284-1290). Candle caveats: do not pass raw bar timestamps to pseudoUtcSeconds (bars at 00:00 UTC are classified as dates and moved to 12:00, breaking order for intraday data); shift with offsetMinutes(ms, getTz()) or keep real UTC and format labels with Intl + timeZone: getTz(); a DST fall-back can produce duplicate shifted times and LWC needs strictly ascending unique times (dashboard enforces +1 s, dashboard.js:1221).

conventions.topic: 24. Navigation integration for /backtest (SPA paths, prefetch, navbar links, active state)
conventions.summary: '/backtest' is already in SpaRouter SPA_PATHS (SpaRouter.astro:62-75, line 71) and in page-transition APP_PATHS used for prefetch/prerender (page-transition.js:68-69), so links to it are SPA-enabled; the page must keep spa={true}. The navbar has no Backtest link today (the old page is reachable only by URL). Desktop links: Navbar.astro:72-76 with the server-side isActive helper (3-12); mobile menu sections Navbar.astro:292-349; after SPA swaps the active link is recomputed by setActiveNavLink() in navbar.js:1713-1742 from hard-coded path rules - a '/backtest' entry is needed there because href === location.pathname fails between '/backtest' and '/backtest.html'. Labels need nav.* keys in en/tr/de. Links use '/<page>.html' (build.format 'file', astro.config.mjs:103-109); requireAuth redirects use relative 'login.html'. In browsers with Speculation Rules a non-SPA page may prerender app paths (page-transition.js:95-140), so do no writes at load time.

conventions.topic: 25. Event targets: window-dispatched app events vs document listeners (dead listeners)
conventions.summary: Window-dispatched: 'journal-changed' (journal.js:20, 165; page-transition.js:493-497; navbar.js:2599), 'trade-saved'/'trade-deleted' (add-trade.astro, trades.js, quick-add.js, navbar.js), 'strategy-saved'/'strategy-deleted' (strategies.js), 'themeChanged' (settings.js:219, 273; theme.js:73; onboarding.js:572), 'timeSettingsChanged' (time-settings.js:118, 126), 'dashboard-refreshed' (dashboard.js:3040, 3053). Document-dispatched: 'ww:page-load' (SpaRouter.astro:453) and the astro:* router events. Many listeners sit on document for window-dispatched events and therefore never fire: 'journal-changed' at dashboard.js:3378, trades.js:1523, calendar.js:1221, strategies.js:1978, premium-dashboard.js:813, add-trade.astro:1709, journals.astro:2225, trades.astro:387, navbar.js:1762; 'themeChanged' at dashboard.js:397, strategies.js:98, calendar.js:98, trades.js:130, admin-core.js:98, script.js:320, quick-add.js:327. Working patterns: PAGE.on(window, 'journal-changed' | 'trade-saved', ...) (dashboard.astro:1399-1407, premium-dashboard.js:808-809) and a MutationObserver on body.class for theme changes (dashboard.js:3184-3195, premium-dashboard.js:92-102). Journal switching itself reloads the page (page-transition.js:500-509), which is what actually refreshes pages today.

conventions.topic: 26. Edge Function conventions (CORS, auth, client calls) and the get-candles discrepancy
conventions.summary: Pattern to copy (ctrader-sync): Deno std@0.177.0 serve + esm.sh supabase-js@2; config via Deno.env.get; CORS allowlist with wildcard patterns and 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization, apikey, x-client-info', OPTIONS -> 204, POST only, jsonRes() helper (ctrader-sync/index.ts:14-79, 160-166); verify the caller with createClient(URL, ANON).auth.getUser(token), use a separate service-role client for writes and filter every query by user.id (168-207). Browser calls: fetch(SUPABASE_URL + '/functions/v1/<fn>') with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> + apikey (navbar.js:2522-2533, ctrader-callback.astro:219-229) or sb.functions.invoke (old backtest.astro:385-387). get-candles (the old backtest's non-crypto data source) differs: Allow-Headers only 'Content-Type, Authorization' and default ALLOWED_ORIGINS ['https://your-domain.com', 'https://wawejournal.com', 'http://localhost:5173', 'http://localhost:4321'] unless the ALLOWED_ORIGINS env is set (get-candles/index.ts:8-13, 89-99). supabase-js functions.invoke also sends apikey and x-client-info, so the browser preflight against get-candles is likely rejected (not verified in a browser) - align it with ctrader-sync if the rewrite keeps it. get-candles does not verify the JWT itself (decodes it only to build the in-memory rate-limit key, 35-61), validates symbol/interval, caps outputsize at 10-500 (217) and proxies Twelve Data time_series (220, response shape 264-273).
